profile.headline: staff software engineer | backend systems | ex-MIT, Google
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Backend engineer specializing in building large-scale applications.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Directed a cross-functional scaling initiative to close the sale of the company’s largest ever enterprise client, expanding onboarding capacity by 15x and menu catalog orchestration throughput by 300x
- Architected and deployed internal LLM developer tooling, leveraging Claude Code and customized MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to automate "Ticket-to-PR" workflows and technical debt removal, accelerating engineering velocity org-wide.
- Overhauled engineering governance by defining new SLO standards and implementing a ‘shift-left’ QA strategy

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Founding engineering member instrumental in defining the technical roadmap; established core SDLC processes, CI/CD pipelines, and stability standards for 0-to-1 launch
- Architected high throughput, event-driven notification platform (SMS, Email, Push) for critical user engagement loops
- Continually met with external vendors to ensure optimal usage of technologies and tools available

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented infrastructural optimizations for Google Lens Android, enhancing latency and reliability for millions of global DAU
- Led the end-to-end architecture and delivery of the user-facing ‘Visual Search History’ feature, integrating with distributed storage systems to handle high-volume data ingestion

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Spearheaded decomposition of legacy payroll monolith into a distributed microservices architecture, increasing throughput by 70%
- Designed financial ledgering and ACH settlement systems, ensuring compliance and accuracy for millions of dollars in daily transaction volume
- Drove automated testing culture, trained engineers in test-driven development
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · MySQL · Distributed Systems

positions.title: Software Engineer (Braintree)
positions.description:
- Optimized critical path credit card BIN lookup, achieving a 97% latency reduction and 50% memory savings by refactoring linear scans into trie-based logarithmic search algorithms
- Developed systems enabling credit card, Apple/Android Pay, and Bitcoin payments for high-scale customers (e.g. Uber)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: - Developed application performance management agent in C++ for PHP, intercepting application code execution to automatically report performance, memory, and database connection metrics

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: Developed music rendering software for Quincy Jones' Playground Sessions

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed software to facilitate Sales on the gTech team. Worked in Python, Django, and Google Web Toolkit (GWT).

positions.title: Financial Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed a module to calculate relative value (rich-cheap) analysis of US Treasury Bonds using Java, interfacing with KDB, Oracle database, and TIBCO I/O

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed a new viewing-experience product for YouTube TV, using (at the time) experimental HTML5/CSS/Javascript features

positions.title: Financial Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed an automated trading platform for trading swaps, rights, and warrants. Directly inserted trades into execution platform.

positions.title: Research Scientist
positions.description: Developed new models on solar plasma loops using new satellite imaging. Published a paper titled "Modeling Evolving Coronal Loops with Observations from STEREO, Hinode, and TRACE" in the Astrophysical Journal.

educations.schoolName: Thomas Jefferson High School for Science and Technology

honors.title: Intel Science Talent Search Semifinalist
honors.description: Was named one of the top 200 up-and-coming high school scientists and engineers in the United States. Submitted an astrophysics paper regarding original research on the solar corona, developing the use of 3D solar imaging to improve simulation accuracy.

honors.title: Siemens Competition for Math, Science, and Technology Semifinalist
honors.description: Submitted original astrophysics research, for which I was recognized as one of the top high school scientists and engineers in the U.S.
